symptom: `list workflows` and `show structure` report fewer workflow activities than the catalog's workflows_data (TestApp Workflow1: 5 vs 8)
cause: cmd_workflows.go countFlowActivities and cmd_structure.go countStructureFlowActivities each recursed over outcome flows only, skipping boundary-event flows and event sub-processes; the catalog had moved to a shared walk in #937 and the executor copies were left behind
insight: Duplicate-resolver drift: fixing one copy of a traversal (#937) left two private copies answering differently. The walk now lives in wfnames, which both catalog and executor already import, so there is one place to add a new sub-flow slot. Grep for every recursion over `workflows.Flow` when one is fixed.
